run_preprocessing_pipeline: run the code preprocessing pipeline on a source code folder with BPE tokenization and binarization
preprocess_dataset_for_training: preprocess a monolingual functions dataset by extracting, tokenizing, splitting, and binarizing source code
apply_fastbpe_tokenization: apply fastBPE tokenization to source code files in multiple programming languages like Python, Java, and C++
train_bpe_codes: train BPE codes on source code data with a configurable number of merge operations
binarize_dataset: binarize tokenized source code data and create vocabulary files for XLM model training
